objective: Extend isolated Arena V2 DEV with playable local Kingdom → Marketplace → Empire → Community journey using the existing BUKLOD economy model; fix partial-material loss without enabling trading SQL or production.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main source 536741f8d97fc9dec91503c89f1c1160e5987ce0 inspected; this is not a production runtime/artifact verification. Production APK, OTA and database are NOT modified.
chosenApproach: Reuse the canonical Arena V2 item/market/material/strategy models with an independent local HTML journey, preserve old Arena and real wallet, repair proportional material consumption, add behavioral Node and smoke tests.
selectionRationale: The existing Arena HTML exposes only one simulated weapon trade and has no discoverable multi-feature economy demo. Also, project materials consumed an entire pack even if a project needed only a small fraction; this silently destroys legitimate virtual value. A separate preview and narrow conservation fix are safer than reworking live client or deploying untested backend.
alternativeApproaches: Make live Market trading depend on untested Supabase SQL now (rejected: production security and agreed deferral)
Rebuild entire app navigation and change production theme to demo economy (rejected: unrelated regression and release scope)
Build a disconnected mock marketplace with its own independent point arithmetic (rejected: duplicated rules and future drift)
